Range 60 feet

Targets 1 creature that owes you a debt or that failed a Will save against one of your effects this encounter

Frequency once per day

Saving Throw Will

A last, devastating hit of mental damage and doom.

The target must succeed at a Will save against your class DC or take @Damage[12d6[mental]] damage and become doomed 1 (@Damage[16d6[mental]] and doomed 2 on a critical failure). On a success, it takes half damage only. This is the last entry the Ledger will ever make on this account.
